snippet.title: Inquisitor Simulator Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Command an inquisitorial monastery where faith, alchemy, and… Creative interrogation techniques are your primary tools as an Inquisitor.
Contain what can be contained. Purge the rest.
Not everything is evil. Not everything is human. No one expects your judgment to be just every time.
…Right?

Wishlist Inquisitor Simulator now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117443/Inquisitor_Simulator/
